qualification.package: Clean public wheel/sdist, both unprivileged image imports and visible source, optional hidden-context request, complete-pipeline dependencies and CLI verified. Offline layers reuse immutable 0.10.0 dependency images, with no model payloads.
qualification.engine: The promoted cache function is AST-identical to the GPU-evaluated prototype. Two 512-square five-second RTX4090 BF16 weight-ring cases received listening acceptance against full six-step controls and retained all 120 video frames. Audio time reduced by about 34%. Owned integration and failure restoration passed focused CPU checks.
qualification.limits: Approximate, explicit opt-in, disabled by default. GPU cache qualification does not include larger, spatially thinned or longer requests, resident FP8 or other GPUs. Public images have CPU checks, not a new GPU image matrix. Profile capacity and application deployment are separate.
